heading: Add a credential to your wallet
sub: Your wallet can hold a credential about you, issued by this service with OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance. Choose one, and this page shows an offer for your wallet to scan. It is made for you, on the sign-in you are using now, and it cannot be redeemed without the code shown beside it.
modeNow: As soon as your wallet asks for it
modeDeferred: Later: your wallet is told to come back for it (deferred issuance)
lifetime: An offer is good for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, and it can be redeemed once.
none: This service offers no credentials here.
offerNow: Your wallet is issued the credential as soon as it redeems this offer.
offerDeferred: Your wallet redeems this offer now and comes back for the credential a little later.
noQr: This offer is too long for a QR code. Open it in your wallet with the link below.
txCodeSay: Then type this Transaction Code into your wallet:
txCodeNote: It is shown here, and only here. It is not in the QR code, so the QR code alone redeems nothing.
openHere: Open in a wallet on this device
noApp: If nothing opens, this device has no wallet app for credential offers: scan the QR code with the wallet on your phone instead, or install a wallet that supports OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance and try again.
doneOffered: Your offer is ready. Scan it with your wallet, then type the Transaction Code.
historySub: Every credential this service still records as issued to you, newest first. One stays listed until it expires.
historyNone: No credential has been issued to you yet.
stateSignedOut: Revoked when you signed out everywhere
removeNote: Removing a credential revokes it: a verifier that checks its status sees it revoked, and it no longer signs you in here. It is not deleted from your wallet. Neither OpenID for Verifiable Presentations nor OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance lets this service delete a credential from a wallet, so delete it in your wallet yourself.
doneRemoved: The credential is revoked. Delete it from your wallet yourself: this service cannot do that for you.
signingAlgSub: The algorithm this service signs the credential with. The configured default is selected. The post-quantum algorithms are defined by drafts, so a wallet or verifier may not accept them yet.
